# jmrp.io — Full Site Context for LLMs

> Personal technical blog and portfolio of José Manuel Requena Plens — R&D Engineer specializing in Embedded Systems, Acoustics, and Industrial Software Development. This document provides comprehensive context for AI models.

> Last updated: 2026-02-21

## About the Author

José Manuel Requena Plens (JMRP) is a multidisciplinary engineer building control systems for renewable energy at Power Electronics (Valencia, Spain). Background in Acoustics research, noise mitigation for the European Space Agency (ESA), and biomedical ultrasound at Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV). Active open source contributor and self-hoster.

- Location: Valencia, Spain
- Current Role: R&D Engineer at Power Electronics
- Education: MSc Acoustics Engineering, BSc Telecommunications Engineering
- Research: Acoustic metamaterials, ultrasound, noise mitigation (ESA)

## Site Sections

### Blog (https://jmrp.io/blog/)

Technical articles on Nginx, MikroTik, networking, security, and DevOps. Written from a practical engineer's perspective with production-ready configurations.

### CV (https://jmrp.io/cv/)

Professional curriculum vitae with detailed work experience, education, skills, and certifications.

### Publications (https://jmrp.io/publications/)

Academic research papers on acoustics, metamaterials, ultrasound propagation, and noise mitigation published in peer-reviewed journals.

### Homelab (https://jmrp.io/homelab/)

Self-hosted infrastructure status page — Mastodon, Matrix, and Meshtastic services running on personal hardware.

### GitHub (https://jmrp.io/github/)

Open source projects and contributions including tools for acoustics, DevOps utilities, and community resources.

### Tools (https://jmrp.io/tools/)

Free browser-based developer tools. All processing runs client-side — no data is sent to servers. Privacy-first design.

## Blog Posts (Detailed)

### 1. Mastering Mutual TLS (mTLS) with Nginx: A Deep Dive
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/blog/001-secure-nginx-client-certificates/
- **Published**: 2025-12-16
- **Tags**: Nginx, Security, mTLS
- **Description**: Implement Mutual TLS (mTLS) with Nginx — create a CA, generate client certificates, configure CRL and OCSP revocation, and enable Zero Trust.
- **Topics covered**: Certificate Authority creation, client certificate generation, X.509 certificate structure, CRL (Certificate Revocation List), OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol), OCSP stapling, Nginx ssl_client_certificate configuration, Zero Trust architecture, OpenSSL commands, certificate chain validation.

### 2. Mastering Virtual Files in Nginx: A Complete Guide
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/blog/002-serve-virtual-files-nginx/
- **Published**: 2025-12-18
- **Tags**: Nginx, DevOps, Containers, Kubernetes
- **Description**: Serve virtual files in Nginx without disk I/O. Covers root vs alias vs try_files, named locations, Kubernetes health endpoints, and containers.
- **Topics covered**: Nginx location matching priority, root vs alias directives, try_files directive, named locations, internal locations, health check endpoints (/healthz, /readyz), Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes, Docker multi-stage builds, Nginx in containers, performance optimization.

### 3. Content Security Policy (CSP) with Nginx: The Complete Guide
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/blog/003-implementing-content-security-policy-nginx/
- **Published**: 2025-12-19
- **Tags**: Nginx, Security, CSP
- **Description**: Master Content Security Policy from zero to A+ — nonces, hashes, strict-dynamic, Trusted Types, bypass prevention, and production Nginx configs.
- **Topics covered**: CSP header syntax, directive types (default-src, script-src, style-src, img-src, etc.), nonce-based policies, hash-based policies, strict-dynamic, Trusted Types, report-uri, report-to, CSP violations debugging, Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, Nginx add_header configuration, sub_filter for nonce injection, common bypasses and mitigations.

### 4. Mastering QUIC and HTTP/3 with Nginx: The Complete Guide
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/blog/004-enabling-quic-http3-nginx/
- **Published**: 2026-01-14
- **Tags**: Nginx, HTTP3, Performance
- **Description**: Deep dive into QUIC and HTTP/3 — technical architecture, security features, and step-by-step Nginx configuration for production deployment.
- **Topics covered**: QUIC protocol architecture, UDP vs TCP comparison, 0-RTT connection establishment, TLS 1.3 integration, connection migration, head-of-line blocking solution, Nginx quic_retry, ssl_early_data, Alt-Svc header, QUIC port configuration, firewall rules for UDP 443, browser support, performance benchmarks.

### 5. Implementing a Tarpit in Nginx: Trap Malicious Scanners
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/blog/implementing-tarpit-nginx/
- **Published**: 2026-01-16
- **Tags**: Nginx, Security, Tarpit
- **Description**: Implement an Nginx tarpit to slow down and trap malicious bots, vulnerability scanners, and brute-force attackers. Includes CrowdSec integration.
- **Topics covered**: Tarpit concept and theory, Nginx limit_rate directive, return 444, intentional slow responses, bot detection via User-Agent and request patterns, CrowdSec bouncer integration, automatic IP banning, log parsing with CrowdSec scenarios, fail2ban alternative comparison.

### 6. MikroTik Honeypot: Trap & Auto-Block Port Scanners
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/blog/implementing-mikrotik-honeypot/
- **Published**: 2026-01-19
- **Tags**: MikroTik, Security, Honeypot
- **Description**: Configure a MikroTik honeypot to detect port scanners, log malicious activity, and auto-block attackers using firewall address lists and the RAW table.
- **Topics covered**: Low-interaction honeypot design, MikroTik RouterOS firewall filter rules, RAW table for early packet drop, address-list auto-population, common honeypot ports (23, 445, 3389, 8080), logging configuration, detection rate analysis, Syslog integration, firewall rule ordering, performance impact assessment.

### 7. MikroTik WireGuard VPN: Complete Dual-Stack IPv4/IPv6 Configuration
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/blog/mikrotik-wireguard-dual-stack-vpn/
- **Published**: 2026-02-14
- **Tags**: MikroTik, WireGuard, VPN, IPv6, Security
- **Description**: Configure WireGuard VPN on MikroTik RouterOS with full IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack. Access your home network with native IPv6 from any connection.
- **Topics covered**: WireGuard protocol on RouterOS, interface creation, key generation, peer configuration, IPv6 ULA addresses, NAT66 vs NPTv6, dual-stack routing, DNS over VPN, split tunneling vs full tunnel, firewall rules for VPN traffic, client configuration (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux), MTU optimization, persistent keepalive.

### 8. MikroTik PPPoE + DHCPv6-PD: Dual-Stack for DIGI Spain
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/blog/mikrotik-pppoe-dualstack-digi/
- **Published**: 2026-02-15
- **Tags**: MikroTik, PPPoE, IPv6, DHCPv6-PD, Networking
- **Description**: Configure PPPoE with DHCPv6 Prefix Delegation on MikroTik RouterOS for DIGI Spain. VLAN tagging, SLAAC, prefix change handling, and firewall rules.
- **Topics covered**: PPPoE client configuration, VLAN tagging (VLAN ID for DIGI), DHCPv6 client with Prefix Delegation, /56 prefix handling, SLAAC (Stateless Address Autoconfiguration), Router Advertisement, automatic prefix change detection via scripting, IPv6 firewall rules, connection tracking for IPv6, dual-stack DNS configuration.

## Developer Tools (Detailed)

### Security Tools

#### CSP Policy Builder
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/csp-builder/
- **Description**: Build Content Security Policy headers interactively. Toggle directives, see real-time policy generation, and get security ratings for your CSP.
- **Features**: Visual directive editor, real-time CSP header output, security score, common policy presets, copy-to-clipboard.

#### CSP Hash Calculator
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/hash-calculator/
- **Description**: Generate SHA-256 hashes for inline scripts. Get ready-to-use CSP directives for your Content Security Policy.
- **Features**: SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 hash generation, CSP-formatted output, multi-script support.

#### Certificate Inspector
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/cert-inspector/
- **Description**: Decode PEM-encoded SSL/TLS certificates or fetch them from a URL entirely client-side. Inspect subject, issuer, validity, SANs, key usage, extensions, and security assessment.
- **Features**: PEM paste or URL fetch, full certificate chain display, SAN listing, key usage flags, validity period, security warnings.

#### HTTP Security Headers Analyzer
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/http-headers-analyzer/
- **Description**: Analyze HTTP response headers for security best practices. Get a security score, recommendations, and detailed analysis for each header.
- **Features**: URL-based analysis, security grading, per-header recommendations, CSP/HSTS/X-Frame-Options checks.

#### Password Generator
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/password-generator/
- **Description**: Generate strong passwords and passphrases using the Web Crypto API. Estimate entropy, crack time, and customize character sets — all client-side.
- **Features**: Cryptographically secure generation, entropy estimation, crack time display, passphrase mode, character set customization.

### Developer Tools

#### Base64 Encoder / Decoder
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/base64-encoder/
- **Description**: Multi-format encoder and decoder for Base64, Base64URL, URL encoding, hex, and HTML entities. Supports file encoding for images, audio, and documents.
- **Features**: Base64, Base64URL, URL encoding, hex, HTML entities, file upload support, bidirectional conversion.

#### Regex Tester
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/regex-tester/
- **Description**: Test and debug regular expressions with real-time match highlighting, capture group extraction, replace mode, and common pattern presets.
- **Features**: Real-time highlighting, capture groups, flags (g, i, m, s, u), replace mode, preset patterns, match count.

#### Cron Expression Builder
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/cron-builder/
- **Description**: Visual cron expression builder with interactive field selectors, common presets, next execution preview, crontab line output, and shareable links.
- **Features**: Visual minute/hour/day/month/weekday selectors, next-N executions preview, crontab output, URL sharing.

#### Color Contrast Checker
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/color-contrast-checker/
- **Description**: Check color contrast ratios for WCAG 2.2 AA and AAA compliance with APCA support, color blindness simulation, and auto-fix suggestions.
- **Features**: WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA testing, APCA algorithm, color blindness simulation (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia), auto-fix suggestions.

#### Timestamp Converter
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/timestamp-converter/
- **Description**: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa. Supports seconds, milliseconds, ISO 8601, RFC 2822, timezone comparison, and auto-detection.
- **Features**: Bidirectional conversion, multiple formats (Unix, ISO 8601, RFC 2822), timezone comparison, auto-detection.

### Network & Server Tools

#### Nginx Config Generator
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/nginx-config-generator/
- **Description**: Generate Nginx server block configurations with upstream blocks, QUIC/HTTP3, rate limiting, tarpit, OCSP stapling, Brotli, CSP integration, and modern TLS best practices.
- **Features**: Server block wizard, upstream configuration, TLS/SSL settings, HTTP/3 QUIC support, rate limiting, security headers, Brotli compression.

#### IP / Subnet Calculator
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/subnet-calculator/
- **Description**: Comprehensive IPv4 and IPv6 subnet calculator with CIDR notation, VLSM planner, range-to-CIDR converter, address info, reverse DNS, and bit boundary visualization.
- **Features**: IPv4/IPv6 CIDR calculation, VLSM planner, range-to-CIDR conversion, reverse DNS lookup, subnet visualization, network/broadcast addresses.

### Embedded & Industrial Tools

#### Modbus Frame Builder
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/modbus-frame-builder/
- **Description**: Build and decode Modbus RTU/TCP/ASCII frames with CRC-16/LRC calculation, register value interpretation, response builder, exception handling, and color-coded byte visualization.
- **Features**: RTU/TCP/ASCII frame modes, CRC-16 and LRC calculation, function code support (01-06, 15-16), register value interpretation (INT16, UINT16, FLOAT32), exception response handling, byte-level visualization.

### MikroTik Tools

#### WireGuard Config Generator
- **URL**: https://jmrp.io/tools/wireguard-config-generator/
- **Description**: Generate complete MikroTik RouterOS WireGuard VPN configurations with dual-stack IPv4/IPv6, firewall rules, NAT, peers, and client config files.
- **Features**: RouterOS script output, dual-stack IPv4/IPv6, firewall rules generation, NAT configuration, peer management, client config file generation (QR code support).

## Technical Implementation

- **Framework**: Astro 6 (Static Site Generation)
- **Styling**: UnoCSS with Tailwind 4 compatible preset
- **Islands**: Preact for interactive tool components
- **JavaScript**: Zero client-side JS except progressive enhancement islands
- **Internationalization**: Fully bilingual (English and Spanish). All pages, blog posts, tools, and metadata available in both languages. Spanish pages use `/es/` URL prefix. RSS feeds per locale.
- **RSS Feeds**: English at https://jmrp.io/rss.xml, Spanish at https://jmrp.io/es/rss.xml
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA compliant, axe-core tested
- **Security**: Content Security Policy with SRI hashes, strict CSP
- **Performance**: 100/100 PageSpeed scores, optimal CLS
- **Content**: MDX blog posts, YAML data collections
- **Hosting**: Static files with Cloudflare CDN
- **Testing**: Playwright E2E + accessibility + Lighthouse audits
